card.name: Inside drug names, before a vowel
card.fires_on: A piece in the middle of a long, less common drug name, just before the next piece that continues the name. It fires on the chunk after the first syllable or two, such as ab in ivabradine or ac in milnacipran.

modes.label: Mid generic drug name
modes.description: Partway through a long generic drug name in an interaction, overdose or warning sentence.
modes.example: Avoid concomitant use of moderate CYP3A4 inhibitors when using iv<<ab>>radine.

modes.label: Inside a web address
modes.description: Partway through a web address, such as the piece after www.

card.writes: It suppresses short vowel pieces such as i, a, o and u, so the name is not continued with a single vowel.
card.plain: It marks the middle of a long drug name that is still being spelled out.
